title: Delete the bee-validating skill and fold its two survivors into bee-planning
action: Per D1 delete the whole skills/bee-validating/ tree. Per D6 the feasibility matrix and the delta rule die with it, no replacement artifact -- they have zero machine coverage, nothing to migrate. Fold exactly two survivors into bee-planning: (a) per D1 the reality gate's SMALLER PATH check becomes a single inline check in bee-planning -- is there a cheaper shape than the one planned; it is the only reality-gate item that saves money rather than spending it; (b) per D5 the merged review wave (one reviewer covering structure + cold-pickup) moves into bee-planning, dispatched when the shape is drafted, findings held until the gate, cost max(reviewer, planning) never the sum. Per D8 spikes become opt-in by CHANGE CLASS routed through the existing spike lane, not a phase step: owed only for migration, security, or a change reaching an external system with a side effect, OR an API/library/technique with no in-repo precedent. Everything else builds directly. Also repair the three fixtures that reference the deleted tree, in THIS cell: scripts/tests/test_gate_bypass_doctrine.mjs (remove the bee-validating row -- the file it reads is gone), scripts/skill_lint.mjs around :112-124 (unguarded readFileSync of the SKILL and its reference; advisory and always exits 0, so it will NOT catch a miss -- delete the check), and scripts/skill-body-budget.json at BOTH the budgets entry and the migrated[] array. Do NOT rewrite bee-hive, bee-swarming, AGENTS.block.md or docs/ -- slice 3 owns those, and test_gate_bypass_doctrine will stay red on them until then; that is expected.
